title: Neural Operator-enabled Topology-informed Evolutionary Strategy for PDE-Constrained Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2607.07682v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The inverse design of physical systems governed by partial differential equations is computationally demanding due to the high dimensionality and non-convexity of design spaces. Generative models for inverse design often lack robustness and transferability, whereas evolutionary strategies are robust but struggle in high-dimensional spaces. This paper introduces a Neural Operator-enabled Topology-informed Evolutionary Strategy (NOTES) that integrates dimensionality reduction, representation learning, and evolutionary optimization for efficient and transferable inverse design. NOTES couples a DeepONet-based neural operator with the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) to perform global optimization in a compact latent space that encodes topology-aware priors while discovering high-performance designs for unseen operating conditions. Applied to nanophotonic beam-deflector inverse design governed by Maxwell's equation

translated_title: 基于神经算子的拓扑信息进化策略用于偏微分方程约束优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.07682v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：由偏微分方程控制的物理系统逆向设计，由于设计空间的高维性和非凸性，计算上非常耗时。用于逆向设计的生成模型通常缺乏鲁棒性和可迁移性，而进化策略虽然鲁棒但在高维空间中表现不佳。本文提出了一种基于神经算子的拓扑信息进化策略（NOTES），该策略集成了降维、表示学习和进化优化，以实现高效且可迁移的逆向设计。NOTES将基于DeepONet的神经算子与协方差矩阵适应进化策略（CMA-ES）耦合，在编码拓扑感知先验的紧凑潜在空间中进行全局优化，同时为未见过的操作条件发现高性能设计。该方法应用于由麦克斯韦方程控制的纳米光子光束偏转器逆向设计。
tldr: 本文提出了一种将神经算子与进化策略相结合的拓扑信息进化方法，在紧凑潜在空间中进行全局优化，实现了高效且可迁移的偏微分方程约束逆向设计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a topology-informed evolutionary strategy integrating neural operators with evolutionary optimization, enabling efficient and transferable inverse design for PDE-constrained problems in a compact latent space.
